intent_snapshot.goal: Implement Slice S2 of Initiative lane-mode-followups: lane-mode readers and guidance are accurate. A store-condition rejection of a lane batch reports its persisted lane children, the resume plan no longer shows integrated or released lane children as enrollable, and the lane next_action text matches what the runner does.

acceptance.assertion: Per Interfaces and State transitions of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes) (source: repository evidence, Review of parallel-batch-lanes-s2-lane-integration findings review-2 and review-3 and Review of parallel-batch-lanes-s5-lane-steward finding review-1; user decision on needs_human: correct the wording, keep the behavior): (a) a kernel store-condition rejection of a persisted lane batch returns a lane-shaped report carrying the persisted lane children and handoffs, not an empty serial plan, and a serial batch keeps its current rejection report; (b) the preflight resume plan marks a lane child integrated or released as already_settled, never enrollable, without changing the plan digest; (c) the lane report names the provision guidance only when a handoff has action provision, and a report with only executor and release handoffs does not; (d) the needs_human wording states that the lane batch has stopped, that its Lane is kept, and that continuing needs a new Batch Authorization, in both the state table text and the resume refusal, and the runner behavior for a persisted needs_human batch is unchanged. Positive: each corrected report is asserted on a lane fixture. Negative: no change to a v1 report byte for byte; a needs_human batch still returns the same report after a fresh confirmation. Bound: no new reason code, state or tool parameter. Agreed seams: tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts, tests/unattended-batch-run.test.ts, tests/unattended-batch-plan.test.ts, tests/batch-plan-reconfirmation.test.ts.

acceptance_results.summary: host-attested QA: all 1 project verification check(s) passed; execution=sha256:3cd193c814e2cde76f7bac7ccb4336f5abb96574be65e328e0c929f82ca87bd6

attestations.summary: All four LF-S2-A1 parts (lane rejection report, already_settled for integrated/released, provision-only guidance, needs_human wording with unchanged runner behavior) are implemented without a new reason code, state or parameter, and each is asserted on a lane fixture. The serial rejection path is unchanged.

advisory_findings.summary: The lane rejection report returns the persisted children, commits and max_parallel, but its handoffs[] is always empty because handoffs are derived per tick and not persisted. This matches the report shape, but the LF-S2-A1 wording 'carrying ... handoffs' is satisfied only as an empty array. The new test asserts Array.isArray only. The agreed seam files unattended-batch-run, unattended-batch-plan and batch-plan-reconfirmation were not modified, so the v1 byte-for-byte negative rests on the existing serial tests staying green.

evidence.trigger: startBatch fails with a store-condition error (e.g. 'kernel store is busy') while a persisted batch_run_state v2 record exists. rejectionReport then calls laneRejectionReport(record, ...) and the report has handoffs: [].
